body.name: \(A^U_r\)
body.def: For each cell mask \(D\), an upper cut \(t\) contributes \(D[(\mathbf 1\{k<t\})_{k=0}^{K-1},(\mathbf 1\{k>t\})_{k=0}^{K-1}]^{\prime}\); a mass-cap branch contributes either \(D[(\mathbf 1_K)^{\prime},0^{\prime}]^{\prime}\) or \(D[0^{\prime},(\mathbf 1_K)^{\prime}]^{\prime}\) according to the selected survivor minimum. Stack over \(x\).
